strings.zh: 小蓝『{VAR:0103:0}你听说了吗？{NEWLINE}火箭队在不久前光顾过这个镇子,{CLEAR}从那之后镇上的这座塔{CLEAR}就开始出现各种灵异事件。{SCROLL}小蓝『我一开始还不信,{NEWLINE}就上去看了一下,{CLEAR}结果就被一群大嘴雀袭击了。{CLEAR}正常来说这种塔里{CLEAR}怎么可能有大嘴雀呢？
strings.en: Green: {VAR:0103:0}, did you hear?{SCROLL}Team Rocket paid this town a visit not{NEWLINE}long ago.{SCROLL}Ever since, all sorts of ghostly things{NEWLINE}have been happening in the tower here.{SCROLL}Green: I didn’t believe it at first, so I{NEWLINE}went up to take a look... and got{CLEAR}attacked by a flock of Fearow!{SCROLL}Normally, how could there be Fearow in a{NEWLINE}tower like this?
strings.notes: Partner branch: #0/#3 Green (male-player route), #1/#4 Red (female-player route).

strings.zh: 小蓝『精灵塔上层发现了火箭队？！{NEWLINE}所以说上面各种不可思议的事{CLEAR}都是火箭队搞的鬼咯。{SCROLL}小蓝『{VAR:0103:0}你先上去看看{NEWLINE}他们在密谋什么,{CLEAR}我随后就到。
strings.en: Green: Team Rocket’s on the upper{NEWLINE}floors of Pokémon Tower?! So all the{CLEAR}weird stuff going on up there is Team{CLEAR}Rocket’s doing, huh?{SCROLL}Green: {VAR:0103:0}, you go on up first and{NEWLINE}see what they’re plotting. I’ll be right{CLEAR}behind you.

strings.zh: 小赤『精灵塔上层发现了火箭队？！{NEWLINE}所以说上面各种不可思议的事{CLEAR}都是火箭队搞的鬼了。{SCROLL}小赤『{VAR:0103:0}你先上去看看{NEWLINE}他们在密谋什么,{CLEAR}我随后就到。
strings.en: Red: Team Rocket’s on the upper floors{NEWLINE}of Pokémon Tower?! So all the weird{CLEAR}stuff going on up there is their doing.{SCROLL}Red: {VAR:0103:0}, you go on up first and{NEWLINE}see what they’re plotting. I’ll be right{CLEAR}behind you.

strings.zh: 火箭队来到紫苑镇的时候,{NEWLINE}我还以为他们会来抢我的派拉斯特,{CLEAR}但是他们连看都懒得看我们,{CLEAR}而是在疯狂地找别的东西。{CLEAR}到底是在找什么呢？
strings.en: When Team Rocket came to Lavender{NEWLINE}Town, I thought they’d be after{CLEAR}my Parasect.{SCROLL}But they didn’t even look our way. They{NEWLINE}were frantically searching for{CLEAR}something else.{SCROLL}What were they looking for?
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | consistency fix (follow-up 4)

strings.zh: 我的派拉斯进化成了派拉斯特,{NEWLINE}陪伴我那么久的小虫虫{CLEAR}就这么被头上的蘑菇给吃掉了,唉。
strings.en: My Paras evolved into a Parasect. The{NEWLINE}little bug that was with me for so long{CLEAR}got eaten by the mushroom on its{CLEAR}head. Sigh.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; ext-review B-024

strings.zh: 这座小镇没有道馆,{NEWLINE}火箭队来的时候只能由我来保护大家,{CLEAR}可是我哪里打得过嘛,{CLEAR}所以当时被揍得很惨。
strings.en: This town has no Gym.{SCROLL}When Team Rocket came, it was up to me{NEWLINE}to protect everyone.{SCROLL}But I was no match for them, so I got{NEWLINE}beaten pretty badly.

strings.zh: 按理说我们警察{NEWLINE}应该是标配卡蒂狗的,{CLEAR}但是在精灵之塔这种阴森的地方执勤,{CLEAR}还是带一只恶系的戴鲁比比较好吧。
strings.en: By the book, we police officers are{NEWLINE}supposed to have a Growlithe.{SCROLL}But on duty in a spooky place like{NEWLINE}Pokémon Tower, a Dark-type Houndour is{CLEAR}the better choice.

strings.zh: 我的口袋妖怪……{NEWLINE}我的口袋妖怪就这么死了……{CLEAR}呜呜呜……
strings.en: My Pokémon... My Pokémon died, just{NEWLINE}like that... Boo hoo hoo...
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | tone review: 就这么死了 = 'just died like that'; kept the blunt 'died' (D-0627)

strings.zh: 我在紫苑镇生活了一辈子了,{NEWLINE}见过的死人比活人还多。{CLEAR}比起不会动的死人,{CLEAR}还是火箭队这种活人更可怕。
strings.en: I’ve lived in Lavender Town all my life.{SCROLL}I’ve seen more dead folks than living{NEWLINE}ones.{SCROLL}And I can tell you, living people like{NEWLINE}Team Rocket are far scarier than the{CLEAR}dead, who can’t even move.

strings.zh: 您好,这里是紫苑镇的精灵之塔。{NEWLINE}虽然很想欢迎您来我们这里参观,{CLEAR}可是塔的上层目前……{CLEAR}目前您还是别上去比较好。
strings.en: Hello, and welcome to Lavender Town’s{NEWLINE}Pokémon Tower.{SCROLL}I’d love to welcome you inside, but the{NEWLINE}upper floors right now are...{SCROLL}For now, it’s best if you don’t go up{NEWLINE}there.

strings.zh: 您好,欢迎您来参观精灵之塔。{NEWLINE}如果您在塔的上层{CLEAR}遇到什么灵异事件请不必担心,{CLEAR}这很可能是幽灵系口袋妖怪引起的。
strings.en: Hello, and welcome to Pokémon Tower.{SCROLL}If anything ghostly happens to you on{NEWLINE}the upper floors, please don’t worry.{SCROLL}It’s most likely caused by Ghost-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon.

strings.zh: 我的皮皮死去了……{NEWLINE}我永远都不会忘记它。
strings.en: My Clefairy passed away... I’ll never{NEWLINE}forget it.

strings.zh: 原来只有特别有钱的人,{NEWLINE}才有能支付起{CLEAR}把自己精灵照片挂墙上的费用。{SCROLL}自从精灵联盟建立后,{NEWLINE}再想要把照片挂到精灵之塔的墙上,{CLEAR}那这个精灵必须在生前{CLEAR}做出过突出贡献才行。{SCROLL}希望精灵联盟能改变一下{NEWLINE}用金钱买特权的社会现状吧。
strings.en: In the past, only very rich people could{NEWLINE}afford the fee to hang their Pokémon’s{CLEAR}photo on the wall.{SCROLL}Since the Pokémon League was founded,{NEWLINE}a Pokémon must have made an{CLEAR}outstanding contribution in its lifetime{CLEAR}for its photo to go up in Pokémon Tower.{SCROLL}I hope the Pokémon League can change{NEWLINE}this world where money buys privilege.
strings.notes: zh logic is loose (原来… / since the League… / hope the League changes money-buys-privilege); translated as written. | consistency fix (follow-up 4); ext-review B-025

strings.zh: 我带着皮丘来看看它的妈妈雷丘。
strings.en: I brought Pichu to visit its mother,{NEWLINE}Raichu.

strings.zh: 想上去看看我的精灵,{NEWLINE}但是据说上面发生了许多灵异事件,{CLEAR}弄得我不敢上去了。
strings.en: I want to go up and visit my Pokémon,{NEWLINE}but they say lots of ghostly things are{CLEAR}happening up there.{SCROLL}I’m too scared to go.

strings.zh: 我的喵喵在上面睡得很安详吧,{NEWLINE}希望现在塔上的灵异事件不要吵到它。
strings.en: My Meowth must be sleeping so{NEWLINE}peacefully up there. I hope the ghostly{CLEAR}goings-on in the tower don’t disturb it.

strings.zh: 我在塔上遇到了我们老师！{SCROLL}她问我要暑假作业,{NEWLINE}我可一个字都没写呢,{CLEAR}吓得我扭头就跑下来了。
strings.en: I ran into our teacher up in the tower!{SCROLL}She asked me for my summer homework,{NEWLINE}and I haven’t written a single word! I{CLEAR}got so scared I turned and ran{CLEAR}straight back down.

strings.zh: 本来我是想{NEWLINE}治退精灵塔上的恶灵。{SCROLL}结果却被一个长着锯齿的喇叭芽{NEWLINE}给吓回来了。{CLEAR}看来我的修行还差得远啊。
strings.en: I meant to drive out the evil spirits in{NEWLINE}Pokémon Tower.{SCROLL}But a Bellsprout with jagged teeth{NEWLINE}scared me right back down. My training{CLEAR}still has a long way to go.

strings.zh: 自从火箭队来过之后{NEWLINE}塔上就频发灵异事件,{CLEAR}是他们在塔上做了什么手脚吗？
strings.en: Ever since Team Rocket came, ghostly{NEWLINE}things keep happening in the tower. Did{CLEAR}they do something up there?
